name: Amber M. Quirk
office: Regional Superintendent of Schools, DuPage County

items.text: Amber Quirk has served as DuPage County regional superintendent of schools since July 2023. She previously served as assistant regional superintendent. She has worked in education for more than 20 years, including time as a teacher and principal. Her campaign says she will require background checks, verify licenses, create school emergency plans, address truancy with support meetings and home visits, and save taxpayer money.
